errors.text_span: 三个测试数据集（Test1、Test2、Test3、Test4 和 Test5）
errors.evidence: The description states there are three test datasets, but then lists five. The chart clearly shows five distinct groups on the x-axis, one for each test set.
The description omits one of the four categories shown in the legend and the chart. The first category, labeled '无' and represented by light green bars, is not mentioned.
The description incorrectly maps the 'i-vector' category to the color green. According to the legend, 'i-vector' is represented by blue bars.
The description incorrectly maps the 'd-vector' category to the color blue. According to the legend, 'd-vector' is represented by yellow bars.

errors.text_span: i-vector 条形是绿色，从约 17% 到约 21% 的高度变化
errors.evidence: The value range provided for the i-vector bars is incorrect. The actual range for i-vector (the blue bars) is from approximately 15.8% (in Test5) to 20% (in Test1).

errors.text_span: 测试集条形是浅灰色，显示 WER 约为 16%。
errors.evidence: The description invents a bar that does not exist in the chart. There is no '测试集' (test set) bar, nor are there any light gray bars.

errors.text_span: 所有条形都以水平显示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are horizontal. The chart clearly displays vertical bars (a column chart).
The description fails to explain the grouping structure of the chart, where four different bars are grouped together for each of the five test sets on the x-axis.
